claims.text: The Jasper architecture serves as a baseline for exploring more sophisticated techniques in speech recognition.
The study evaluated models using batch normalization with ReLU as the best performing configuration for larger models.
The research also tested different types of normalization and activation functions to determine their effectiveness in model performance.
